headline: Fast-Paced Synonym Race Game for English Classes
outcomes: Students rapidly recall multiple synonyms for a given word, building lexical breadth
Learn to distinguish subtle meaning differences between near-synonyms
Build streaks and momentum that reinforce vocabulary through spaced repetition
Develop fluency by retrieving words under timed pressure rather than slow recall
howItWorks: The AI picks a target word matched to your chosen topic and difficulty level
Students race to type as many synonyms as they can before the timer expires
Each unique, valid synonym earns points — consecutive correct answers build streak bonuses
After the round, the class reviews which words were accepted and discusses the distinctions
teacherUseCases: Pre-writing warm-up to expand the word pool students draw from in essays
Review of a specific word field after a vocabulary lesson
Competition-style review game that generates genuine engagement

faq.q: How does the streak bonus work?
faq.a: Each correct synonym in a row multiplies your score. Miss one and the streak resets. This mechanic rewards students who push for depth rather than stopping after the first obvious answer.

faq.q: What if two students submit the same synonym?
faq.a: Both get credit. There's no race penalty for matching — the competition is in who finds more synonyms, not who finds unique ones.

faq.q: Can the game focus on a specific vocabulary set?
faq.a: Yes. Set the topic and difficulty in session settings. The AI targets words relevant to that topic area, so a business English class would see professional register vocabulary.

faq.q: Will phones work for typing synonyms quickly?
faq.a: Yes — a phone or tablet is fine. The text input is optimised for mobile. Students join via a browser link, no app or student account needed.
The easy difficulty setting uses common, high-frequency words where students should know 2–3 synonyms comfortably. Harder levels target more nuanced vocabulary.
